en.title: Current executives from Seoul National University business club accused of information cartel, 2 billion won in unlawful gains
en.summary: Financial professionals who were members of a Seoul National University business club are suspected of forming an information cartel to obtain undisclosed merger and acquisition information over several years, allegedly generating 2 billion won in improper profits.

stories.title: Lee calls for thorough probe of mine blast, vows necessary measures

en.title: Lee calls for thorough probe of mine blast, vows necessary measures
en.summary: President Lee Jae Myung requested a transparent investigation into a mine explosion in the Demilitarized Zone that wounded three South Korean soldiers, stating he will implement appropriate actions based on findings that North Korean mines likely caused the incident.

en.title: Information cartel uncovered among Seoul National University business club members, suspected of 2 billion won in unlawful gains through merger and acquisition information
en.summary: An information cartel involving alumni of a Seoul National University business club was discovered, with members suspected of using merger and acquisition information to generate 2 billion won in improper profits.

stories.title: Lee Calls for Prompt, Thorough Probe into DMZ Blast

en.title: Lee Calls for Prompt, Thorough Probe into DMZ Blast
en.summary: President Lee Jae Myung called for a swift and transparent investigation into a suspected land mine explosion in the Demilitarized Zone that injured three South Korean soldiers the previous week.

stories.title: Joint Chiefs of Staff: N. Korean Land Mines Likely Caused Last Week’s DMZ Explosion

en.title: Joint Chiefs of Staff: N. Korean Land Mines Likely Caused Last Week's DMZ Explosion
en.summary: South Korea's military stated that North Korean land mines probably caused an explosion in the Demilitarized Zone last week, with officials indicating they will take appropriate action if this assessment is confirmed.

stories.title: N. Korean land mines highly likely cause of DMZ blast: S. Korean military

en.title: N. Korean land mines highly likely cause of DMZ blast: S. Korean military
en.summary: South Korea's military determined that North Korean land mines very likely caused a recent explosion in the DMZ that injured two South Korean soldiers, and pledged accountability and corresponding measures pending final confirmation.

en.title: Ukrainian Outlet Slams Kyiv's Disclosure of N. Korean POW Repatriation
en.summary: A Ukrainian English-language publication criticized the Ukrainian government's decision to publicly disclose the transfer of two North Korean prisoners of war to South Korea, suggesting this action upset an allied partner.

stories.title: Seoul says DMZ blast was highly likely caused by North Korean mine

en.title: Seoul says DMZ blast was highly likely caused by North Korean mine
en.summary: South Korea's military concluded that a North Korean mine probably caused a September 21 explosion in the DMZ that injured three officers, based on analysis of recovered fragments and materials, and pledged appropriate measures if North Korean involvement is confirmed.

stories.title: S. Korea Summons Ukraine’s Top Diplomat in Seoul to Express Regret over POW Disclosure

en.title: S. Korea Summons Ukraine's Top Diplomat in Seoul to Express Regret over POW Disclosure
en.summary: South Korea summoned Ukraine's top diplomat in Seoul to formally express concerns about how Kyiv handled the handover of two North Korean prisoners of war to South Korea.

stories.title: Seoul summons Ukrainian envoy over N. Korean POW disclosure, demands apology

en.title: Seoul summons Ukrainian envoy over N. Korean POW disclosure, demands apology
en.summary: South Korea called in Ukraine's acting ambassador to protest the disclosure of North Korean prisoners of war transfers, demanding explanation and apology for alleged confidentiality agreement breach.

stories.title: Defense Minister: Seoul Will Take Corresponding Steps if N. Korean Mine Caused Explosion in DMZ

en.title: Defense Minister: Seoul Will Take Corresponding Steps if N. Korean Mine Caused Explosion in DMZ
en.summary: South Korea's defense minister stated the government will respond appropriately if North Korea was responsible for a recent DMZ explosion involving a land mine.

stories.title: S. Korea Demands Explanation, Apology from Ukraine in N. Korean POW Dispute

en.title: S. Korea Demands Explanation, Apology from Ukraine in N. Korean POW Dispute
en.summary: South Korea is demanding an explanation and apology from Ukraine following a dispute over two North Korean prisoners of war that Ukraine recently transferred to Seoul. The disagreement arose after Ukrainian President Zelenskyy publicly disclosed the transfer, while a Ukrainian presidential aide later denied any prior agreement with Seoul to keep the matter confidential.
